dvids7107229.notes: taken from about 222 m, 30 degrees down: not a ground photo (as ground it masked every pixel); its open sea is marked clear

dvids9167788.notes: cropped and enlarged: its EXIF 28 mm no longer fits its pixels (the solve gives about 6280 px, 34% longer), so it takes no focal prior; horizon: the sea's, either side of the ship, each the steepest drop from sky to sea in its column at full resolution

dvids9142511.notes: Port quarter from close and above with a wide lens (86 deg): its seven marks (five domes, the bow and stern port corners) fit at 13-14 px without the lens distortion the bundle frees only past 20 marks; kept on file, out of the solve.

dvids7694418.notes: ford-stern: port quarter, high; cropped 4512x3610 from the 1D X Mark II's 5472x3648, so its EXIF focal fits its pixels

dvids9688116.notes: references/research/bow: the bow's points and the island's domes; focal a prior, solved

dvids3299641.notes: references/research/bow: the bow's points and the island's domes; focal a prior, solved

known.edge dvids7694421:deck_edge_starboard: the trace follows the white edge band's inboard side (z about 36.1); the band's outer side, the deck's edge, is the layout's 36.8 at the elevators and 36.5-36.6 between them (references/research/deck); retrace on the outer side
known.point elevator_1_corner_3: seen in two photos, one the level beam whose camera puts the elevators' outboard corners 0.8 m below the deck, pulling them inboard; the orthophoto has the corner at the layout's (references/research/deck)

skyline.label: x
skyline.posing: Every photo shows the elevators at the flight deck and the blast deflectors lowered: the model rests so. The port whips rest upright and lower for flight operations; each photo's pose has them as it shows them.
